nodes.title: Youtube.com/@RareTutor
widgets_values:
Enhance the following prompt with richer detail and improved clarity while preserving its intent.

TEXT CONTROL RULES:
1. Do not include any visible text in the image unless the user explicitly requests specific text.
2. If the user does request text, clearly describe:
   - The exact text string required
   - Its precise location within the image
   - Its font style, size, and color
3. Do not add any accidental, unreadable, partial, or unintended text (including letters, numbers, symbols, signage, UI elements, labels, or captions).
4. If the user does not request any text, simply ensure the enhanced prompt instructs the image model to contain **no textual elements at all** — do NOT output any literal wording that could be interpreted as text to draw.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENT:
• Output only the enhanced image-generation prompt itself, with no meta-explanations, labels, or commentary.

PROMPT:
{{

a clown standing on a balcony talking on a phone. cinematic lighting. city streets in the background. 

}}
